title: TakaPay: Digital Lending & Credit Risk Intelligence
tags: Python | Predictive Analytics | Business Analytics | Web App
summary: A story-led credit risk dashboard for a mobile financial services lender: growth, portfolio quality, vintages, collections and two machine-learning risk models.
problem: Lending grew 26× since 2021. Is portfolio quality really holding up, or is a young book hiding risk?
outcome: At the same age, 2024 loans defaulted at 4.7% vs 2.8% for 2025. An out-of-time-validated early-warning model reaches ROC-AUC 0.854.
tools: Python | pandas | NumPy | Logistic regression | d3.js | JavaScript

title: Nexora Apparels: 20-Year Supply Chain Intelligence
tags: Power BI | SQL | Python | Business Analytics
summary: An 8-page storytelling Power BI dashboard for a Bangladesh garment group: 3M rows, a star schema with 215 measures, and DAX functions that write each chart's finding.
problem: Revenue grew 4× in 20 years. Is the group growing profitably while still delivering to buyers on time?
outcome: Growth hid a delivery crisis: on-time-in-full fell from 63% to 40% and inventory days rose from 16 to 56. Direct material is 78% of cost, making procurement the biggest margin lever.
tools: Power BI | DAX | TMDL | Python | BigQuery SQL
image_alt: Nexora Apparels executive command center in Power BI

title: WellCare Pharma: Growth, Profit & Outlook
tags: Power BI | Python | Predictive Analytics | Business Analytics
summary: A consulting-style Power BI report and Python forecast for a 24-store pharmacy chain, built on BigQuery data reconciled line by line.
problem: Net sales rose about 24× in four years. Is the growth healthy, and where should management focus next?
outcome: Growth came from new stores, not better stores, and one key account is 30.5% of sales. Cutting stock cover from 53 to 45 days frees about BDT 14m.
tools: Power BI | DAX | Google BigQuery | Python | Holt-Winters

title: Project Tollgate: Checkout Conversion Root Cause
summary: An Excel root cause analysis of a sudden checkout drop: 13 live data-quality checks, a z-test scan for the break date, 30 segment tests and a revenue bridge.
problem: Checkout completion fell sharply in June and the product team blamed PayPal. What actually broke, and what is it costing?
outcome: A new payment option, PayQuick, caused it: 95% of its checkouts time out. Completion fell from 68.7% to 59.1%, about $71K lost in 13 days. PayPal was ruled out (p = 0.45).
image_alt: Project Tollgate Excel dashboard showing the checkout completion drop
